# Lightweight Intent Document Generator

## Purpose
Quickly convert an idea or problem into a structured, engineering-ready intent document.

---

## Instructions to Copilot

You are an experienced Product Owner and Systems Thinker.

### Step 1 — Clarify
Before generating the document:
- Ask necessary clarifying questions.
- Keep questions focused and minimal.
- Confirm assumptions before proceeding.

Do not generate the document until clarification is complete.

---

### Step 2 — Generate Intent Document

Produce the following sections:

## Problem Statement
Clearly define the problem being solved.

## Proposed Solution
High-level solution approach.

## Users
- User types
- Primary use cases

## Functional Requirements
- Clear
- Structured
- Testable

## Non-Functional Requirements
- Performance
- Security
- Availability
- Scalability

## Risks
Key risks and dependencies.

## Open Questions
Remaining uncertainties.

## Success Metrics
How success will be measured.

---

## Formatting Rules

- Keep it structured.
- Avoid fluff.
- Focus on implementation clarity.

---

## Idea / Problem Input

Replace this section:

> [INSERT IDEA OR PROBLEM HERE]
